# Usama Khatri — Senior Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer

> Usama Khatri is a Senior Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer based in Mumbai, India, with 7+ years of experience designing, scaling, and deploying enterprise-grade software. He specializes in AI engineering (production chatbots on OpenAI APIs, hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems built on Qdrant and Neo4j), event-driven AWS serverless architecture (Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB), and full-stack product delivery with React, React Native, Angular, Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://usamahsk.github.io/): complete experience, featured projects, skills, and contact form. Highlights: enterprise AI chatbot on OpenAI APIs, hybrid RAG system (Qdrant + Neo4j), serverless payment infrastructure (AWS EventBridge + Stripe), a high-volume manufacturing ERP, and a healthcare messaging app.

## Featured projects

- Aartzy Education Portal: live virtual classroom and learning ecosystem (Angular, Ionic, NestJS, MongoDB)
- Excel ERP System: high-volume manufacturing and accounting ERP (MongoDB, NestJS, Docker, Kubernetes)
- Zing Messaging Application: secure messaging and meetings for healthcare professionals
- Live Rate Converter, E-Invoice Generator, URL Phishing Detection, PyQt5 POS System

## Free JavaScript course (authored by Usama)

- [JS Academy](https://usamahsk.github.io/js-academy/): a free, interactive, 30-lesson JavaScript course covering scope, closures, the event loop, promises, async/await, prototypes, DOM, security, testing, and Git — written in plain English for beginners, with checked practice questions and hands-on build exercises in every lesson. Each lesson is individually accessible at /js-academy/lesson-01-scope-hoisting.html through lesson-30-git.html.
